versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ym-product-listing-check for auditing product listings.
- Checks for missing required fields, spec inconsistencies, and description risks (e.g., exaggeration, conflicting info).
- Clearly marks range and assumptions based on submitted info (e.g., only title vs. full listing).
- Outputs concise checklists: missing/ambiguous items, consistency conflicts, risk words, and actionable suggestions.
- Separates critical issues needing correction before listing, and optimization suggestions.
- Works fully offline, with no platform integrations or automatic rule fetching.
